answer: Each agent must title one exclusive cadastral parcel for a single registered anemometer and lock a slashable land bond. The land office publishes the parcel id and logger serial. In a review window the on-site logger signs a fresh nonce plus a wind trace, which peers accept only if it matches neighboring stations while a gale is actually moving through. A river delta or karst-bench plot is valid, but never two keys on one title. Each fake identity therefore costs another parcel, another certified logger, and another full bond—linear, and steeper as remaining plots are bid away.
